description: A gray power strip with a long gray cord lies on a blue bedspread in front of a pillow. The right hand reaches in from the lower right, touches the power strip, then grips and lifts the plug end at the strip’s right side before pulling it up and away and letting the cord fall back onto the bed; the left hand comes in to steady the strip briefly, making the strip a two-hand object for a moment before the right hand releases.
